Switzerland / 46.81°N, 9.26°E

Laax

A big ski area with five snow parks and the largest halfpipe in the world.

Plan a trip to Laax

In short

Laax at a glance.

The LAAX ski area reaches from 1,100 m up to 3,018 m on the Vorab Glacier, with 216 km of slopes and 30 lifts, and is reached from Flims, Laax and Falera.

Region
Graubünden, Switzerland
Altitude
1,100 to 3,018 m (Vorab Glacier)
Ski area
216 km of slopes, 30 lifts
Freestyle
Five snow parks and the largest halfpipe in the world
Lift passes
Arranged by us, ready to collect at the ticket desks in Flims, Laax and Falera
Nearest airport
Zurich (about 1.5 hours)

Who is it for?

Skiers and snowboarders of every level, from children to adults, and freestyle riders who come for the snow parks and the halfpipe.

When to go?

Winter for skiing, the snow parks, sledging, ice skating and cross-country skiing; summer for biking, hiking, river rafting and the Rhine Gorge.

How do you get there?

About 30 minutes by car from Chur and 1 hour 45 minutes from Zurich. By train to Chur, then through the Rhine Gorge to Ilanz and on by PostBus in about 30 minutes. laax.com
